run_main: run the main function to reproduce HALOMI sentence and token level evaluation scores
run_sentence_level_hallucination_detecti: run sentence level hallucination detection evaluation across translation directions using percent correct pairs
run_sentence_level_omission_detection: run sentence level omission detection evaluation on non-hallucinated translations using percent correct pairs
run_token_level_hallucination_detection: run token level hallucination detection on target side tokens using evaluate token level features
run_token_level_omission_detection: run token level omission detection on source side tokens using evaluate token level features
